correctness.rationale: Exact two-stage Chebyshev coefficients recover M=1-(C1+C2)/2+C1*C2/8. Independence yields E[M²]-1=(μ²-4μ+v)(μ²-12μ+v+32)/64 with no omitted higher moments. Factor signs prove the complete strict/critical/unstable classification. Direct rational enumeration gives E[M]=-31/32 and E[M²]=409/256 for clients 1 and 6; iid strong law yields log(√7/4)<0 almost surely. Shared-client squared gain is exactly 17/128 in the witness. A standalone symbolic/rational checker replays the identities; finite checks supplement, not replace, proof.

value.rationale: Sharp necessary-and-sufficient distribution-free mean/variance stability criterion for a natural independently stage-resampled variant of a published stabilized stochastic optimizer, plus an exact separation of same-batch L2 contraction from independent-stage exponential L2 explosion despite first-moment and almost-sure convergence. It provides a concrete sampling-design safeguard and nontrivial complete phase diagram, not a generic stability-test restatement.
